_doc: First-run guided tutorial. Each step shows ONE plain sentence (max 20 words, enforced by tests), spotlights `target` (a key resolved by src/ui/tutorial.js) and advances by itself when `done` is true. done.kind: statSince {stat,gte} (counter increase since the step began) | earnedSince {gte} (money earned since the step began) | flag {name} (set by the UI, e.g. panel:backpack, inspect) | ack (the player pressed 'Got it'). assist (granted once per save, documented in the README): freeRolls n | rollMoney n (tops the balance up to n roll prices, only if it is lower) | ensureItem {type|tpl, n, tier} (gives PRACTICE items - worth $0, never sellable for money - only if the backpack lacks them) | demoWave (starts the scripted tutorial wave: no loss penalty, no wave progress). reward: same spec as level rewards (rollPrices, freeRolls, backpack ...), granted exactly once per save, also when the tutorial is replayed. topic: the short phrase used in the 'what you will miss' list of the skip confirmation. To add a step, add an object here (and a target key in ui/tutorial.js if it needs a new spotlight).

steps.text: Press Roll to get your first random item.
New items wait in your Backpack. Open it.
Press Place on the drill, then click a lit tile.
Place the Market Stall where the drill's arrow points.
Watch your money rise. The drill digs, the stall sells.
Spend money to grow. Open the Shop and buy an upgrade.
Free rolls recharge over time. Use the one we gave you.
Rarer items are worth far more. Tap any item to read its rarity.
Luck makes rare items likelier. Levels and upgrades raise it.
Mutations are bonus traits like Golden. The Refinery can change them.
Turrets defend your base. Place one anywhere on the grid.
Monsters attack in waves. Watch your turret defend the base.
Later you can Rebirth: restart for permanent bonuses. Take a peek.
Fuse merges same-tier items into a rarer one. Tick three, press Fuse.
Sell items you don't need. Press Sell on any item.
You know the basics! Help and Replay live in Settings.
